decisionsTitle: The Administrator controls the site's door: «Înscrieri publice deschise», «Locurile libere le dau doar eu», «Pe site acum» and the places alert
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-03:** «cumva trebuie să pot controla mai bine» — after closing the public registration by setting the waiting list to «Fără listă de așteptare», which then also refused his own «Oferă-i un loc acum».

**Decision.** Five changes, none of which ever blocks a staff verb:

1. **«Înscrieri publice deschise»** (`events.public_registration_open`, on by default — every event keeps the door its dates give it). A real tick in the editor's «Perioada de înscriere», and the same tick beside «Locuri» on the registrations page (Administrator only, asked first, audited `event.public_registration_changed` with `via: "registrations"`, the row's `version` moved so an open editor is told; the Organizer reads the state). Every editor save audits it too — the one-date save and the series save alike — as it audits the two other settings below (`event.public_registration_changed`, `event.free_places_by_offer_only_changed`, `event.places_alert_changed`: who, when, from → to, only for a value that moved). Unticked, inside an open window the public card and page draw `PAUSED` — «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite de organizatori.», no button — and the register page says so instead of the form; the server refuses the public form and its emailed link for another person (`PUBLIC_REGISTRATION_PAUSED`), off the caller's row and again under the event lock. Every staff door is untouched: the staff entry, the desk, «Trimite-i oferta», «Dă-i un loc», «Oferă-i un loc acum», «Mută pe lista oficială», «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare», the invitations (an invitation's form is the invitation's door, §647). A registration already sent goes on: its address confirmation is not a new entry. Outside the window the dates speak, as before.

2. **«Locurile libere le dau doar eu»** (`events.free_places_by_offer_only`, off by default). A tick under «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat». Ticked, a registration from the **public** form never takes a free place: it joins the official waiting list in its order beside a free place, or is refused like a full race when the line takes nobody (a limit reached, or 0). It is one condition inside the one allocator's opening (`placeForNewcomer`, `newcomerJoinsLine`), on the entry's channel — `public` for the public form, its link for another person, a family's form and reservation, a verified runner's restart through it, and the address confirmation of a row the public form wrote; `staff` for every staff verb, an invitation and a late signature keeping the place it was given — never on `kind`. Every allocator call names its channel (the option is required, so no door can forget). The capacity formula is untouched: the switch only ever says «not for this entry» to a free place, so it cannot seat anybody past the capacity — overbooking is impossible by construction, and the locked transaction `tests/concurrency/capacity.test.ts` checks is the same one. A staff entry takes a free place as before while nobody waits; once somebody waits it queues behind them, as §615 and §872 already said («never ahead of anyone») — the free places are then given by «Trimite-i oferta» to whom the Administrator chooses. The public card never invites a direct registration while it is ticked: «Locurile se dau din lista de așteptare» and the waiting list's button beside free places; free places with a line that takes nobody is `PAUSED` with its own words («Locurile rămase le dau organizatorii: nu te poți înscrie direct pe site.»), never «s-au ocupat». **While it is ticked, no place goes out by itself either, «Da» or «Nu».** The automatic offers have one gate (`fillAvailableSpots` → `offersWaitlistAutomatically`), and it now reads `domain/waitlist.ts#offersOnItsOwn` — «Da» and the tick off. Without it the tick did not do what it says: with the default «Da», the public entrant it had just sent to the line was offered the free place in the same transaction (the review of 2026-11-03), so a stranger from the site still took the place the tick keeps for the staff to give. So a place freed, added or released waits for the staff — «Trimite-i oferta», «Dă-i un loc», «Oferă-i un loc acum» — and the readers that tell somebody whether places go out by themselves read the same rule (`repository.ts#lineOffersOnItsOwn`): the waiting person's position sentence and its `WAITLIST_JOINED` email, «Ce îi spui», «Termene», the queue panel's order (by form sent, as for «Nu», §627) and the maintenance sweep, which no longer locks such an event to do nothing. Untick it and «Da» or «Nu» decides again; the next allocator write offers the line what is free. The editor's visible note under the tick says it («…și niciun loc nu pleacă automat, nici cu „Da” mai sus: fiecare loc liber îl dai tu.»), and so does «Pe site acum», under its sentence while the tick is in force: «Cu «Locurile libere le dau doar eu», niciun loc nu pleacă automat: fiecare loc liber îl dai tu.» **The tick only counts where places are counted:** on an uncapped event (a duplicate, a series date, a cap lifted while it stayed on) it sends nobody to the line, the card stays «Înscrie-te», and a cap lifted while people wait offers them the places as «Da» says (§147). One statement of it for the allocator, `domain/waitlist.ts#publicEntryQueues`, which is false without a capacity (every door passes the locked row's `capacity`), and its twin for the card (`registration-cta.ts`, an uncapped event's `availablePlaces` is null). The door's «free places, no line to join» is one predicate (`registration-cta.ts#offersOnlyShut`), asked by the card and the register page alike. The register page's join form, which the line's door leads to, opens with the card's own «Locurile se dau din lista de așteptare» whenever places are free — the tick, or somebody waiting (§615) — where it said «Mulțumim! Toate cele N locuri s-au ocupat», false beside free places.

3. **«Oferă-i un loc acum» is never refused by the waiting list's limit.** The entry ends with the person offered, not waiting, so neither the door's check nor the allocator asks the limit — 0, «Fără listă de așteptare», included (`thenOffered`, carried only by `enterOnWaitlistByStaff` with `offerNow`, from the official list's add form and from a line of the internal list). The offer runs in the same transaction; refused (an unconfirmed supplementary place), it takes the whole entry back, so nobody is ever left waiting past the limit. **«Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» and «Mută pe lista oficială» keep honouring the limit** (§348): they leave the person waiting, which is exactly what the limit bounds.

4. **«Pe site acum»** — one line under «Locuri» on the registrations page, read off the public card's own predicate (`registrationCta`, through `public-now.ts#readPublicDoor` over `readPublicPlaces`), never a second copy of its rules: «Pe site acum: butonul «Înscrie-te» — primul venit ia un loc liber.», «Pe site acum: «Intră pe lista de așteptare» — X din Y locuri pe listă.», or «Pe site acum: înscrierile sunt închise — <de ce>» (the dates, the tick, the free places the organizers' alone with no line, the line full, no line, cancelled, over, not on this site), with «Schimbă în editor» to the fold that changes it (`#box-registration-window`, `#box-places-control`, `#box-registration`; a `<details>` opens on a fragment inside it). Read live, never from the public cache. An event with no capacity has no «Locuri»: the line and the tick stand alone.

5. **«Anunță-mă când rămân N locuri»** (`events.places_alert_at`, null — off — by default; 0 is «only when full») with its memory `events.places_alert_sent` (null, `LOW`, `FULL`). The Administrators and Superadministrators with an address are emailed through the outbox (`PLACES_ALERT`, RO and EN, the counts on the bold facts line, the button to the event's registrations) once when the free places drop to N or fewer and once when they reach 0; a drop straight to 0 sends the «full» one alone; re-armed only when the free places climb back above N, so a place freed and taken again near the end sends nothing more. Free is the capacity less the allocator's occupied count, the number «Locuri» says first. Checked in the transaction of every allocator write, under its lock — `allocateOrWaitlist`, `fillAvailableSpots` (every path that frees, adds or offers a place comes through it), a family's reservation, a send of invitations — never by an interval job; the memory column is written without moving the row's `version`. Switching the setting off forgets the last crossing.

**«Locuri» names what holds each place still to sign** (amending §896; the production review of 2026-11-03). Its parenthesis said «declarație de semnat sau ofertă activă» while 2 of the 13 places held were unanswered invitations — and a family's reservation is counted there too. The sentence now counts each kind from the same `countOccupied` the outlook reads (`capacity.ts#placesTaken`, the four numbers `NoFreePlaceError` already names): «Ocupate 175: 162 confirmați și 13 care își țin locul până semnează — 9 declarații, 2 oferte, 2 invitații.» A kind at 0 is left out, a family's as «rezervări de familie»; each counted with `countForm` (RO «1 ofertă», «2 oferte», «20 de oferte»; EN «1 offer», «2 offers»), and the kinds always add up to the places held.

**Everything that speaks of the door says the same** (the review of 2026-11-03, round three). The door was right on the card, the page and the server; four other places still read only the dates:

- **The lapsed-place email** (`DECLARATION_HOLD_EXPIRED`, §638) said «te poți înscrie din nou» with «Înscrie-te din nou» behind a door the organizers had shut, and offered a free place the tick keeps for them. It now reads the door as the card does — `holdLapsedNext` over `publicDoorOpen` and `newcomerJoinsLine` on the `public` channel, the person coming back through the site's form: unticked, «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite acum de organizatori. Dacă mai vrei să vii, scrie-ne din pagina de contact.» and no button; with «Locurile libere le dau doar eu», the waiting list beside free places, or — when the line takes nobody — «Locurile rămase le dau organizatorii: nu te poți înscrie direct pe site.», «scrie-ne» and no button. Outside the window the dates speak first, as on the card. The family sitting's message (§543) says «pe lista de așteptare» for a person with no reserved place by the same rule (`render.ts#waitlistTakesNewcomer`): somebody waiting, or the tick, and a line that takes them — it was silent beside free places.

- **«Înscrierile s-au deschis»** (`REGISTRATION_OPENED`, §146) went to every «Anunță-mă» address at the window's opening while the page said registration was stopped, and the addresses were deleted with it. While the door is unticked an open window announces nothing and keeps the addresses (`interestAction`: `wait`), and the forecast on «Emailuri» foresees nothing; the first run after the tick is back, the dates still open, tells each address once. The registrations page's tick wakes the job when it opens the door, as the editor's save already does.

- **The calendar feed** said «Înscrierile sunt deschise» with the form's address behind a shut door: it says the page's «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite de organizatori.», with no address (`calendarRegistration` → `PAUSED`). One predicate for the server, the card and the feed: `public-door.ts#publicDoorOpen`.

- **`PLACES_ALERT`** is about an event's places, never a registration: the club's email-text legend and preview no longer offer `{currentStatus}` for it (`email-copy-fields.ts#NO_REGISTRATION`).

Two more. **The event's JSON file** (§751) carries the three settings beside «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» — `registration.freePlacesByOfferOnly`, `publicRegistrationOpen`, `placesAlertAt` — each written only when it is not what a file without it means, so a file of an event that never touched them still reads in the release before them, never the alert's memory; the diff names them, and an import over an event writes them through the editor's save, audited. **A new N forgets what the alert said for the old one**, in every save path — the editor's save, its fields-only save, a series' save, an import over an event: a raised N is told at the next allocator write that finds the free places at or under it. A save that keeps N keeps the memory, so an editor saved ten times sends nothing more. The note under the tick said the staff's entries «iau un loc liber ca până acum»: a staff entry takes a free place only while nobody waits (§615, §872), and it now says so.

**What the line is told says what the allocator does** (the review of 2026-11-03, round four). Three sentences still spoke of a line served by itself while the tick — or «Nu» — leaves every place to the organizers:

- **`WAITLIST_JOINED`** told everybody the tick sent to the line beside free places «{event} este complet momentan». It says «este complet» now only while every place is held and the tick is not in force; otherwise — «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» in force, or a place nobody holds beside the line («Nu», or after the close, when no offer goes out by itself either) — «La {event}, locurile le dau organizatorii, pe rând: te-am trecut pe lista de așteptare și îți scriem când îți putem da un loc.», and an Administrator's resend «Locurile le dau organizatorii, pe rând: îți scriem când îți putem da un loc.» where it said «Te vom anunța dacă se eliberează un loc.» Read when the email is rendered, as the person's place in the line is (§629), by the allocator's own rule: `publicEntryQueues` on the `public` channel, then the capacity formula's count with the line's claim left aside (`render.ts#waitlistByHand`).

- **`WAITLIST_SPOT_OFFER`** said «după acest termen, locul trece la următorul de pe lista de așteptare» whatever the event did. It says so only while places go out by themselves — the allocator's own gate, `offersWaitlistAutomatically`, read at render time; otherwise «după acest termen, organizatorii pot da locul altcuiva.» / “after that, the organizers may give the place to someone else.”

- **«Când se eliberează un loc, primești un email și ai N ore să confirmi — altfel locul trece mai departe.»**, under the full event's button, above the register page's join form and in the editor's preview of it, is «Locurile le dau organizatorii, pe rând: când îți pot da unul, primești un email și ai N ore să confirmi.» while no place reaches the line by itself. One rule for the three, `registration-cta.ts#offersByItself` over the allocator's `offersOnItsOwn`; the public row carries «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» beside the tick for it, and a copy cached before it reads as «Da», the column's default.

**Nothing promises a notice no freed place sends** (the review of 2026-11-03, round five). Two sentences still did, beside the ones round four corrected, and a text the club saved could replace the corrected words unseen:

- **The join sentence** — «Intră pe lista de așteptare — te anunțăm pe email când se eliberează un loc.», under the full event's lead on the page and on the listing card, and in the register page's join notice and the editor's preview of it — was printed whatever the two settings said. It follows the offer line's rule now (`counted-phrases.ts#waitlistJoinPhrase` over `registration-cta.ts#offersByItself`): while no place reaches the line by itself — «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» in force, or «Nu» — «Intră pe lista de așteptare — organizatorii îți scriu pe email când îți pot da un loc.» / “Join the waiting list — the organizers email you when they can give you a place.”

- **`WAITLIST_JOINED` on a full event with «Nu»** said «Te vom anunța dacă se eliberează un loc.» while a freed place reaches nobody by itself. «… este complet momentan, așa că te-am adăugat pe lista de așteptare.» stays, since it is true; the promise after it, in the first send and in an Administrator's resend, is the organizers': «Locurile le dau organizatorii, pe rând: îți scriem când îți putem da un loc.» It reads the fact the position sentence beside it is worded by — the standing's `autoOffer`, the allocator's `offersOnItsOwn` (`templates.ts#organizersGiveThePlaces`) — so the two sentences of one email cannot disagree. With «Da» and the tick off, a full event keeps «Te vom anunța dacă se eliberează un loc.»

- **«Emailuri»**: a text the club saves for `WAITLIST_JOINED` or `WAITLIST_SPOT_OFFER` replaces the words that follow the two settings, whatever they are set to. The editor of those two messages says so under the box, in one line: «Textul implicit se schimbă după «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» și «Locurile libere le dau doar eu»; un text salvat aici îl înlocuiește, oricum ar fi setate.»

**Refused.** Closing the site by setting the waiting list to 0 — what the owner did — because it also closed the line to the staff's own offers and said «Locurile s-au ocupat» to the public about places that were free; the limit stays a bound on the line, the door has its own tick. A toggle button for either switch (the owner, 2026-10-14: an on/off setting is a real tick box). A job that polls the places for the alert — it would wake the database for nothing (§334); the write that takes a place is the only moment it can cross. Leaving «Da» to offer the line a place while the tick is on, with a warning beside the tick — the first draft did, and its own test showed the stranger offered the free place at once; a warning would leave the tick's words («doar eu») false by default, and the hole open unless the owner also found the other setting. Re-arming the alert on every editor save — the memory goes only with the N it was for, or saving any field would send the same email again. «Te vom contacta» in the lapsed-place email behind a shut door: nobody is contacted by itself, so the email says «scrie-ne» and the footer's «Scrie-ne» link is the way. Writing «full» or «not full» into the `WAITLIST_JOINED` row when it is queued: a resend, or a place freed before the email leaves, would then call a free place «full» — the email says what holds when it is sent, as the line's position does (§629). Refusing a club's own text for those two messages, or rewriting it by the settings: the words the club saves are the club's, and the editor says what they replace.
changelogLine: - **More control over registration from the site** — «Înscrieri publice deschise» stops the site's button and the public form at once (editor and beside «Locuri», staff verbs untouched); while it is off the «Anunță-mă» addresses wait instead of being told registration opened, and the calendar and the lapsed-place email say it is stopped; «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» sends every public entry to the waiting list and offers no place by itself — you give each one; the event page, the card, the join form and the waiting-list emails say who gives the places, with «Nu» too, and never «full» beside free places, and «Emailuri» says a saved text replaces those words; «Oferă-i un loc acum» no longer refused by the waiting list's limit; «Pe site acum» says what the public sees; «Locuri» names what holds each place still to sign (declarations, offers, invitations, family reservations); «Anunță-mă când rămân N locuri» emails the Administrators, afresh when you change N; the event's JSON file carries all three. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an internal event whose window is open and whose «Înscrieri publice deschise» is unticked, when a visitor opens its card, its page or its register page, then no registration button is drawn and the page says «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite de organizatori.» — the register page with the way back instead of the form, a press the server refused for it included; when the public form or its emailed link for another person is posted, then the server refuses it with `publicRegistrationPaused` — off the caller's row and again under the event lock — and writes nothing; and every staff entry, the desk, «Trimite-i oferta», «Dă-i un loc», «Oferă-i un loc acum» and an invitation still work. The tick is set in the editor's «Perioada de înscriere» and beside «Locuri» by an Administrator alone, the latter asking first in the words of the way it goes, and each change from the registrations page or from either editor save writes one `event.public_registration_changed` audit row with from and to (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with a capacity, «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» ticked and a free place, when a registration from the public form confirms its address, then it joins the waiting list in its order and takes no place — or, when the waiting list takes nobody (a limit reached, or 0), the form is refused like a full race and nothing is written — while a staff entry with nobody waiting still takes the free place; the condition is on the entry's channel, never on `kind`, and the capacity formula is unchanged; while it is ticked no place is offered to the waiting list by itself, whatever «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» says — a freed or free place waits for an Administrator's offer, and unticking it lets «Da» offer the line the free places again; the public card shows the waiting list's door and never «Înscrie-te», its register page leads with «Locurile se dau din lista de așteptare», never «s-au ocupat», and with no line to join both say «Locurile rămase le dau organizatorii: nu te poți înscrie direct pe site.»; on an event with no capacity the tick changes nothing (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose waiting list is full or has a limit of 0, when an Administrator presses «Oferă-i un loc acum» — from the official list's add form or from a line of the internal list — then the entry ends with the person offered a place (a counted free one, or the one supplementary place the dialog named) and is never refused by the waiting list's limit; an offer refused takes the whole entry back; «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» and «Mută pe lista oficială», which leave the person waiting, are still refused by the limit (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event chosen on the registrations list, when the page renders, then «Pe site acum» says, from the public card's own predicate, whether the site shows «Înscrie-te» (a free place for the first to come), the waiting list's door with the line's length and limit, or closed with its reason — the dates, the tick «Înscrieri publice deschise», the free places the organizers' alone with no line, the line full, no line — and links to the editor's fold that changes it; while «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» is in force it adds that no place goes out by itself (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with a capacity chosen on the registrations list, when some places are held by people who have not signed, then «Locuri» says the places taken as the confirmed and the rest, and names the rest by kind with its count — declarations to sign, open offers, unanswered invitations, family reservations — from the same occupied count, a kind at 0 left out, the kinds adding up to the places held, in Romanian and English with each count's own form (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with «Anunță-mă când rămân N locuri» set, when an allocator write — public or staff — leaves N or fewer places free, then every Administrator and Superadministrator with an address is emailed `PLACES_ALERT` once, in the write's own transaction; when the places reach 0, once more; nothing more while they stay at or under N; again only after they climb back above N, or after a save — the editor's, its fields-only save, a series' or an import over the event — changes N, while a save that keeps N sends nothing more. Off, nobody is emailed. The email names the Administrator and the event, never a registration's status, and the club's email-text legend says so (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an internal event whose window is open, when a `DECLARATION_HOLD_EXPIRED` is rendered, then what the person can do now follows the site's door as the card reads it: with «Înscrieri publice deschise» unticked it says «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite acum de organizatori.» and «scrie-ne», with no button; with «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» on a capped event it offers the waiting list beside free places, never «te poți înscrie din nou», and when the line takes nobody it says «Locurile rămase le dau organizatorii: nu te poți înscrie direct pe site.» with no button; outside the window the dates speak as before; and a family sitting's message says «pe lista de așteptare» for a person with no reserved place whenever a public entry would join the line — somebody waiting, or the tick — and the line takes them, in both languages (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given addresses left in «Anunță-mă» on an event whose «Înscrieri publice deschise» is unticked, when the maintenance job runs inside the window, then no `REGISTRATION_OPENED` is queued, every address is kept and the forecast on «Emailuri» foresees none; when the tick is set again while the dates still say open, the next run queues one per address and deletes the rows, as at the opening; a window that closes meanwhile drops them with no message (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an internal event whose window is open and whose «Înscrieri publice deschise» is unticked, when the calendar feed, the event's `.ics` or Google's add-event link is built, then registration's line is the page's «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite de organizatori.» / “Registration on the site has been stopped by the organizers.”, with no address of the form; before and after the window the dates speak as before, and ticked again the line is open with the form's address (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with «Locurile libere le dau doar eu», «Înscrieri publice deschise» or «Anunță-mă când rămân N locuri» set, when it is exported, then the file's registration block carries each one that is not what a file without it means — and only then, so a file of an event that never touched them reads in the release before them — and never the alert's memory; imported as new or over an event the three are written through the editor's own save (over an event named in the diff and audited), export, import and export again gives the same configuration, and a file without them reads as the door open, the tick off and no alert (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a person on the waiting list, when their `WAITLIST_JOINED` is rendered — the first send or an Administrator's resend — then it says «{event} este complet momentan» only while every place is held and «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» is not in force; with the tick in force, or a place nobody holds beside the line, it says that the organizers give out the places one at a time and that we write when we can give one — «La {event}, locurile le dau organizatorii, pe rând: te-am trecut pe lista de așteptare și îți scriem când îți putem da un loc.»; and while no place reaches the line by itself — «Nu», or the tick — it never promises «Te vom anunța dacă se eliberează un loc.»: a full event with «Nu» keeps «este complet momentan» and promises «Locurile le dau organizatorii, pe rând: îți scriem când îți putem da un loc.», in the resend too, while a full event with «Da» and the tick off keeps «Te vom anunța dacă se eliberează un loc.» — in both languages, as it stands when the email is rendered (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an offer of a place from the waiting list, when its `WAITLIST_SPOT_OFFER` is rendered, then the sentence after the deadline says the place passes to the next person on the waiting list only while places go out by themselves («Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat» on and «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» off); otherwise it says «după acest termen, organizatorii pot da locul altcuiva.» / “after that, the organizers may give the place to someone else.” (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose waiting list takes people, when the full event's door, the register page's join form or the editor's preview of it says how an offer works, then while no place reaches the line by itself — «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» in force, or «Nu» — it says «Locurile le dau organizatorii, pe rând: când îți pot da unul, primești un email și ai N ore să confirmi.» / “The organizers give out the places one at a time: when they can give you one, you get an email and N hours to confirm.”, never «Când se eliberează un loc…»; with «Da» and the tick off it keeps «Când se eliberează un loc, primești un email și ai N ore să confirmi — altfel locul trece mai departe.» (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
